headline: Quarterly growth was uneven, with AI‑led firms outpacing traditional players.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from low single digits at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved at HCLTech and Coforge, while Infosys trimmed its FY guidance and Wipro saw profit dip. AI revenue contributed materially for several firms, but overall guidance remains modest.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Companies reporting AI revenue (Infosys, LTM, HCLTech, TCS) posted higher profit growth or large‑deal wins.

themes.title: Margin pressure on legacy players
themes.detail: Infosys cut FY revenue guidance to 1‑2% and posted modest margin expansion, while Wipro's operating margin stayed flat.

themes.title: Headcount and attrition trends
themes.detail: HCLTech added 6,450 staff but attrition stayed above 12%; Wipro reduced headcount, indicating cost‑control focus.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%.
11.5% YoY revenue growth, 21% profit jump, and strong AI revenue of $219 m.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY guidance was cut.
Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but net profit fell 1.9% and headcount was reduced.
